integration_rules: Do not modify, hook, patch, inject into, or impersonate the official ChatGPT app.
Use ordinary Android app permissions and user-visible intents/shares only.
Treat LuHm OS as a separately signed sibling APK and verified upstream contract, not as an install-time package replacement.
No daemon, shell, ADB, root, Shizuku, Knox bypass, or hidden/system API may be required for normal operation.
Fail closed if an active runtime path introduces Termux-specific paths, su/root execution, Shizuku, or privileged Android permissions.
